MoonPay to Acquire North Capital for Over $60 Million to Expand Tokenized Real-World Asset Business MoonPay plans to acquire private-markets investment platform North Capital in an all-stock transaction valued at over $60 million, subject to regulatory approval. North Capital will become a wholly owned MoonPay subsidiary upon closing. North Capital has processed approximately $9 billion in primary and secondary market transactions. Its affiliates hold relevant SEC registrations and provide infrastructure for securities tokenization, fundraising, asset management, clearing, custody and secondary trading. MoonPay said the acquisition will support its expansion into tokenized real-world assets. — link

Forward Industries Plans to Raise $25 Million to Acquire More SOL Forward Industries has entered into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor to sell 3.125 million shares of common stock at $8 per share, generating approximately $25 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use the net proceeds to acquire additional SOL, expand its SOL treasury and increase SOL holdings per fully diluted share. The offering is expected to close on or around September 24. — link

Bitwise Survey: Crypto Allocations Among Institutions Are Mostly 1%–2%, With None of 15 Interviewed Cutting Exposure During a 50% Market Decline Bitwise interviewed investment professionals at 15 endowments, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, family offices and public companies between late March and April 2026. All crypto-owning respondents held Bitcoin. Crypto allocations ranged from 0.5% to 13% of investable assets, with most between 1% and 2%. None reduced exposure as the crypto market fell roughly 50% between October 2025 and April 2026, while several added to their positions. Nearly all respondents already use or plan to use spot crypto ETFs. Bitwise said governance, operational and reputational concerns remain the main barriers to larger allocations. — link
